senses.definition: To speak so quietly or unclearly that others cannot understand the words.
senses.example: Please say the address clearly instead of mumbling.

senses.definition: To chew food, often with a repeated crunching sound.
senses.example: We munched on carrots as we walked home.

senses.definition: A soft, low sound that continues for a little while.
senses.example: We heard a murmur of voices outside the classroom.
She murmured the words so the sleeping baby would not wake.

senses.definition: A part of your body that can tighten and make your body move or work.
senses.example: A muscle in my lower leg felt tight after the race.

senses.definition: A place or organization that collects, cares for, and shows objects or works so people can learn about them.
senses.example: The museum displayed a collection of ancient toys.

senses.definition: A part of a fungus that often has a stem and a cap and makes tiny spores. A spore can grow into a new fungus.
senses.example: A mushroom grew beside the old tree stump after the rain.

senses.definition: To grow or spread very quickly.
senses.example: The crowd mushroomed when the parade reached the square.

senses.definition: To say something very quietly, often because you are annoyed or talking to yourself.
senses.example: He muttered that the rules were harder than he had expected.

senses.definition: The spreading network of fine threads that makes up much of a fungus.
senses.example: Hidden mycelium grew through the damp wood.

senses.definition: A close partnership where a fungus grows with a plant’s roots.
senses.example: The mycorrhiza helped the young tree get minerals from the soil.

senses.definition: Something puzzling or difficult to explain.
senses.example: It was a mystery why the door opened by itself.

senses.definition: A story in which someone tries to solve something puzzling.
senses.example: I checked out a mystery about a missing bicycle.

senses.definition: To make someone feel puzzled about how something happened or works.
senses.example: The moving lights mystified us until we found the small puppet theater.
